eventMetadata.context_description: Trader consensus on Polymarket clusters tightly around 26–28°C for Shanghai's highest temperature on May 7, driven by the latest China Meteorological Administration (CMA) and global model ensembles from ECMWF and GFS forecasting a peak near 27°C under a persistent high-pressure ridge promoting subsidence, clear skies, and southerly winds advecting warmer moist air from the south.
